thread:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync — need a short, punchy solution one-pager + benchmark narrative + webinar ask for enterprise secure deployments (SLA/VPC/on-prem). Goal: field-ready by next Wed.
Jon (growth): +1. What's the target audience? CISO vs infra platform?
Maya (marketing): Primary: platform/CISO for purchase intent. Secondary: engineering leads for dev eval.
Priya (product): For the one-pager can we include a 3-line tech callout: hosting modes + SLAs + KMS/HSM? Also a benchmarking snapshot: latency @ 95th, cost per 1k tokens, failover time.
Lena (solutions): I can draft the architecture diagram and a quick 'how it maps to buyer needs' section.
Arman (sales): Routing note — inbound from the webinar should create SFDC lead with "Enterprise-Secure" tag and route to AE queue EU/US based on region. Also capture "deployment-interest" (hosted/dedicated/private).
Maya (marketing): Nice. Webinar plan: 30 min (20 demo + 8 Q&A + 2 CTA). Need one slide with benchmarking story and one customer-style scenario (healthcare fintech).
Jon (growth): Benchmarks — we should be transparent: show p95 latency, token cost, and fallback behavior (model variant + region). Add a short methodology note: synthetic workload, realistic prompt set, 95th measured over 10k requests.
Priya (product): I'll provide the benchmark numbers and short methodology blurb by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (solutions): For messaging iteration: propose A/B for the hero line: A) "Predictable inference for regulated teams" B) "Ship LLM features with enterprise SLAs" — we'll test in webinar CTAs.
Arman (sales): Also include hotline routing for high intent: form opt-in -> immediate AE ping in Slack channel #sales-enterprise.
Maya (marketing): Owner assignments: One-pager copy + design — Maya; Benchmark data + methodology — Priya; Diagram + customer scenarios — Lena; Webinar script + slide deck — Jon; Routing/ops flow — Arman.
Jon (growth): Timeline: first drafts by Mon EOD, internal review Tues, final assets Wed morning, dry-run Wed afternoon.
Priya (product): Noted. I'll attach the raw benchmark CSV in the doc thread when ready and include the scripts used.
Lena (solutions): For the one-pager layout: top 3 bullets (capabilities), center bench table (p95 latency, cost), right column (deploy modes + SLAs + compliance callouts). Keep it printable one page.
Maya (marketing): CTA variations for webform: "Request secure deploy eval" vs "Schedule an enterprise demo" — we'll A/B in the landing page from the webinar.
Arman (sales): Routing OK. OpsBot: create Jira epic "MARKETING-ENT-SAFE-ONEPAGER" and link assets.
OpsBot: Created epic MARKETING-ENT-SAFE-ONEPAGER-4321 assigned to Maya — due 3 days.
Maya (marketing): Thanks! Quick ask — everyone add a 1-line summary of blockers in the epic. Ping me if any timing slips. :rocket:
